title: Bear cub in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- bear cub body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- belly lighter shade -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='16' ry='15' fill='#C4884E'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='90' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#7A4A22'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='90' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#7A4A22'/>
  <!-- paws lighter -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='92' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#C4884E'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='92' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#C4884E'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <rect x='30' y='52' width='40' height='11' rx='5' fill='#E8402A'/>
  <rect x='58' y='58' width='11' height='20' rx='4' fill='#FF6B4A'/>
  <rect x='58' y='58' width='11' height='5' rx='2' fill='#FFB3A0'/>
  <!-- scarf stripe -->
  <rect x='36' y='52' width='5' height='11' fill='#FFB3A0'/>
  <rect x='50' y='52' width='5' height='11' fill='#FFB3A0'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='25' cy='70' rx='8' ry='11' fill='#8B5A2B' transform='rotate(-20 25 70)'/>
  <ellipse cx='75' cy='70' rx='8' ry='11' fill='#8B5A2B' transform='rotate(20 75 70)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='24' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='15' r='9' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='15' r='9' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='15' r='5' fill='#C4884E'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='15' r='5' fill='#C4884E'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#D9A66C'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='37' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#3A2412'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 44 Q50 50 56 44' stroke='#3A2412' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='30' r='4' fill='#2B1A0E'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='30' r='4' fill='#2B1A0E'/>
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='28.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFF3E0'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='28.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFF3E0'/>
</svg>
